shopify_token_help: Enter a new Admin API access token for {shop}. Then validate access so Luma can read the store again.
shopify_authorize_help: Shopify asks you to approve access to read orders, products, inventory, returns, and fulfillment, and to change inventory and fulfillments. Luma changes them only through actions your workspace allows. You can cancel before approving.
shopify_access_check_failed: Luma couldn’t check this store’s Shopify access. {error}
shopify_access_history_full: Access to older orders is on. How far back Luma can read depends on the history the store keeps.
shopify_access_history_limited: Luma can read orders from the last 60 days. Older orders need approval from Shopify and a new authorization.
shopify_access_customers_unavailable: Customer details aren’t available until Shopify approves access to customer data and the store grants it.
shopify_access_missing: Shopify hasn’t granted access to {permissions}. Reconnect the store to request it.
shopify_page_description: Read orders, payments, fulfillment, and stock directly from your Shopify stores.
shopify_page_empty: No Shopify store is connected. Connect a store in Apps to browse its records.
shopify_records_help: Read a record from this store, then follow its linked orders, variants, inventory, returns, and refunds.
shopify_records_id_placeholder: ID from the Shopify admin URL
shopify_record_error_not_found: Luma couldn’t find this record in Shopify, or the connection is no longer available. Orders older than 60 days need access to older orders.
shopify_record_error_forbidden: This connection doesn’t have access to this record. Check its permissions in Apps.
shopify_record_error_invalid: Choose the matching record type and enter its Shopify ID.
shopify_context_no_order_id: This order has no Shopify order ID, so Luma can’t read live details from Shopify.
shopify_recovery_help: Review one exact change, approve it, then check the result in Shopify.
shopify_recovery_expired: This preview expired. Refresh the fulfillment details and review the action again.
shopify_recovery_interrupted: The connection was interrupted, so Luma couldn’t confirm the result. Refresh to see the saved recovery before you try again.
shopify_recovery_hold_help: Luma releases only this hold. Other holds stay in place.
shopify_recovery_destination_help: Moves all remaining items. Items already fulfilled stay at their original location.
shopify_recovery_expires: This preview expires at {time}. If the order changes in Shopify, review it again.
shopify_stock_description: Set available stock in Shopify to the quantity your ERP reports. Review and approve the change, then check it in Shopify.
shopify_stock_rules: Luma changes only available stock in Shopify. Your ERP stays the source of truth. Someone else who can approve changes must approve each correction.
shopify_stock_expired: This review expired. Sync the ERP and refresh before you review again.
shopify_stock_interrupted: The connection was interrupted, so Luma couldn’t confirm the result. Refresh to see the saved correction before you continue.
shopify_stock_missing_sources: To correct stock here, Luma needs an active Shopify connection and a matching ERP source. Check that the SKU and location are linked in both systems, then sync both.
shopify_stock_delta: {count, plural, one {{delta} unit in Shopify} other {{delta} units in Shopify}}
shopify_stock_expires: This review expires {time}. If stock changes in either system, review it again.
shopify_blocker_correction_write_access: Reconnect Shopify and allow Luma to change inventory.
shopify_blocker_correction_untracked: Shopify didn’t confirm that it tracks stock at this location.
shopify_blocker_correction_stale: Stock data is more than five minutes old. Refresh before you review a correction.
shopify_blocker_correction_already_match: Shopify already shows the same quantity as your inventory system. No correction is needed.
shopify_blocker_recovery_write_access: Reconnect Shopify and allow Luma to change fulfillments.
shopify_blocker_recovery_incomplete: Shopify sent incomplete fulfillment details. Refresh before you continue.
shopify_blocker_recovery_closed: This fulfillment order is closed or canceled.
shopify_blocker_recovery_not_allowed: Shopify doesn’t allow this action in the fulfillment’s current state.
shopify_blocker_recovery_hold_gone: The selected hold no longer exists.
shopify_blocker_recovery_cancellation_pe: The fulfillment service must accept the cancellation before this order can move.
shopify_blocker_recovery_location_unavai: Shopify can’t move all remaining items to this location.
shopify_subscriptions_help: Reconnect Shopify to repair subscriptions. Scheduled scans recover missed changes. Registration does not prove delivery.
shopify_blocker_correction_bundle_parent: Bundle stock is derived from its components. Review component stock instead.
